description: This PHP source file defines the final class UriNormalizer, which provides static methods to normalize and compare URIs according to RFC 3986. It includes constants for various normalization options and methods for normalizing URIs and checking their equivalence.

classes.name: UriNormalizer
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to normalize and compare URIs, including options for case normalization, decoding, path adjustments, and query parameter sorting.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Returns a normalized URI based on specified normalization flags, applying transformations like case normalization, decoding, path adjustments, and query sorting.

methods.name: isEquivalent
methods.description: Checks if two URIs are equivalent after normalization with specified options.
